title: Stochastic Spatial Metapopulation Modelling of HPAI Control and Poultry Restocking on Jolly Island
summary: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) outbreaks require rapid control during active transmission and evidence-based decisions on the safe restocking of depopulated farms. We developed a stochastic spatial SEIR-based metapopulation model for a synthetic HPAI outbreak on the fictional Jolly Island. Farms were classified as `Broiler-2', `organic duck', or `Other' production systems. The model incorporated local, environmental, movement-mediated, and distance-dependent transmission, together with reactive and preventive culling, production-specific confinement, and capacity-based restocking.…
